mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Liberate the designated planet and eliminate the mandated number of Illuminate hostiles in order to televise broadcasts of the sector's pacification.
mo_brief.translated: 解放指定星球，歼灭规定数量的光能者敌军，以便向全境播送本星区平定实况。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Shattered Illuminate divisions are consolidating on SENGE 23. High Command has authorized a live broadcast of their imminent eradication to every loyal home.

To bolster this initative, the recently restored DSS (Democracy Space Station) has deployed, newly equipped with the Eagle Gas Storm to enable widespread chemical peacekeeping.

Liberate SENGE 23 and eliminate 400,000,000 Illuminate hostiles.
items.translated:
新重大指令

光能者残部正在新戈23重整旗鼓。最高指挥部已批准，将这场即将到来的歼灭行动向所有忠诚的家园进行实况转播。

为壮大此役声势，近日修复完毕的民主空间站已部署就位，并新装飞鹰毒气风暴，以便开展大范围化学维和。

解放新戈23，歼灭 4 亿（400,000,000）光能者敌军。

items.original:
DSS MAINTENANCE UPDATE

The Democracy Space Station has been offline for recalibration. Engineers have been altering the functionality of the Eagle Storm Tactical Action, in collaboration with C.O.B. Genetics, to deploy aerosol-based deterrents.

The DSS has been returned to operational service.
items.translated:
民主空间站维护更新

民主空间站此前离线，进行重新校准。工程人员与 C.O.B. 遗传学部门合作，改造了飞鹰风暴战术行动的功能，用以投放气溶胶类威慑剂。

民主空间站现已恢复服役。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

Buoyed by inspiring footage of the Federation's greatest heroes decimating its greatest enemies, Maelstrom Tank sales to the public have skyrocketed. Citizens are clamoring for the opportunity to defend their homes and families with their very own Tank. 

The Maelstrom Tank is available for Helldiver use in perpetuity.
items.translated:
重要指令达成

联邦最伟大的英雄们歼灭最凶恶敌人的英姿鼓舞人心，受此激励，风暴漩涡坦克的民用销量一路飙升。公民们纷纷请愿，渴望拥有属于自己的坦克，亲手保卫家园与家人。

风暴漩涡坦克现已永久供绝地潜兵使用。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Unrelenting enemy aggression has put production of the Maelstrom Tank in jeopardy. To recoup costs, the Helldivers are ordered to aid the creation of a public awareness sales campaign. Footage of the Helldivers obliterating Freedom's enemies could increase pre-sales, providing the funding needed to save the project.

GATRIA and WASAT have just come under attack. Deploy to defend these planets, utilizing the Maelstrom Tank.
items.translated:
新重要指令

敌军攻势步步紧逼，风暴漩涡坦克的生产已岌岌可危。为挽回成本，绝地潜兵奉命协助打造一场面向公众的宣传销售活动。潜兵歼灭自由之敌的影像有望提振预售，为挽救该项目提供所需资金。

盖尔崔亚与天樽二刚刚遭到进攻。即刻部署，保卫这两颗行星，并投入使用风暴漩涡坦克。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER FAILED

Insufficient materials have been harvested by the Helldivers to fulfill production quotas for deluxe Maelstrom Tank features. This has caused significant distress amongst the early investors who were promised these features as incentives, resulting in a precipitous drop in pre-sales and a decrease in share value.

As a result, the Maelstrom Tank project is now at risk of termination.
items.translated:
重要指令失败

绝地潜兵采集到的材料不足，无法满足“风暴漩涡”坦克豪华配置的生产配额。当初向早期投资者承诺这些配置作为激励，如今承诺落空，投资者极度不满，预售量骤降，股价随之下跌。

因此，“风暴漩涡”坦克项目如今面临终止风险。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Production of Maelstrom Tanks for civilian and military use is proceeding on schedule. Now, deluxe features offered as incentives for early investors must be fabricated. The Helldivers are ordered to dismantle 5,000,000 Automaton Tanks to repurpose their engine cooling systems as climate-controlled cupholders, and harvest 25,000,000 Chargers to convert their carapaces to vibration-insulation panels.
items.translated:
新重要指令

“风暴漩涡”坦克的民用与军用生产正按计划推进。如今，作为早期投资者激励的豪华配置必须投入制造。绝地潜兵奉命拆解 500 万（5,000,000）台机器人坦克，将其引擎冷却系统改作恒温杯架；并猎杀 2500 万（25,000,000）只冲锋虫，将其甲壳改作隔振板。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

The Helldivers liberated PHACT BAY and MARFARK. AM Defense has already broken ground on massive factories for large-scale Maelstrom Tank fabrication. Pre-orders from qualifying citizens for home defense Tanks have already sold out, evidencing the eagerness of Super Earth citizens to exercise their natural-born freedoms.
items.translated:
重要指令达成

绝地潜兵解放了丈人一湾与玛尔法克。AM 国防部已破土动工，兴建超大型工厂，用于大规模制造“风暴漩涡”坦克。符合资格的公民已抢购一空家用防御坦克的预售份额，足见超级地球公民行使与生俱来自由的迫切之心。

items.original:
STRATEGIC ALERT

The Automaton Incineration Corps has been reported on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.
items.translated:
战略警报

据报，机器人炽灼部队已出现在文德米塔里克斯主星。

items.original:
MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK

A minor Terminid outbreak has occured on FRONTERIA. It is evident that some dissidents continue their hopeless effort to disrupt citizen confidence in the TCS+. The Helldivers are ordered to put down this small, low-threat outbreak.
items.translated:
终结族小规模爆发

边陲发生小规模终结族爆发。显然，仍有少数异见分子执迷不悟，妄图动摇公民对TCS+的信心。绝地潜兵受命扑灭这场规模小、威胁低的爆发。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Enemy aggression prevents the long-term construction of the new Maelstrom Tank, threatening our citizens' inherent right to self-defense. Liberate MARFARK and PHACT BAY immediately.
items.translated:
新重要指令

敌方侵略行径，令新型「风暴漩涡」坦克无法长期建造，公民固有的自卫权因此受到威胁。立刻解放玛尔法克与丈人一湾。
